name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-mine
title: Super Mario World Styled Mine
description:
A collection of rails, mine carts, walkways, supports, suspensions, lanterns, stones, spikes, traffic cones, and stony cave ground made referencing both Donkey Kong Country's "Mine Cart Madness" and Super Mario World's castles and ghost houses. Can be used alone or in combination with any of SMW's original FG3 sets. Uses BG2. Compatible with berries.

Requires palette 6 for all major assets. Expects the first half to be left alone, and changes colours 8-F. Expects the second half of palette 2 to be left alone for the traffic cone. Stones use various colours across 2-7 but will tolerate alteration that keeps a similar brightness gradient. Four palettes are included to easily integrate your mine assets into a neutral, icy, volcanic, or murky setting.

Requested by bandicoot.
